reason: The policy's Modify Items provision only allows changing each item to a different variant/option of the same product type ('each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option'); it does not authorize deleting items from an order outright. The candidate call passes item_ids with 3 items but new_item_ids as an empty list, which is not a valid same-position, same-product replacement as required by the tool schema itself ('Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product'). There is no tool or policy procedure for removing items from a pending order without replacement — only whole-order cancellation or item-for-item modification is supported. Additionally, this call would irreversibly lock the order (status becomes 'pending (items modified)', after which the agent cannot modify or cancel it further), so it must not be executed based on a mismatched, unsupported action shape.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.
This action can only be called once... The agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore.
